1 module Battle::CatchAndStoreMixin
    2   #=============================================================================
    3   # Store caught Pokémon
    4   #=============================================================================
    5   def pbStorePokemon(pkmn)
    6     # Nickname the Pokémon (unless it's a Shadow Pokémon)
    7     if !pkmn.shadowPokemon?
    8       if $PokemonSystem.givenicknames == 0 &&
    9          pbDisplayConfirm(_INTL("Would you like to give a nickname to {1}?", pkmn.name))
   10         nickname = @scene.pbNameEntry(_INTL("{1}'s nickname?", pkmn.speciesName), pkmn)
   11         pkmn.name = nickname
   12       end
   13     end
   14     # Store the Pokémon
   15     if pbPlayer.party_full? && (@sendToBoxes == 0 || @sendToBoxes == 2)   # Ask/must add to party
   16       cmds = [_INTL("Add to your party"),
   17               _INTL("Send to a Box"),
   18               _INTL("See {1}'s summary", pkmn.name),
   19               _INTL("Check party")]
   20       cmds.delete_at(1) if @sendToBoxes == 2   # Remove "Send to a Box" option
   21       loop do
   22         cmd = pbShowCommands(_INTL("Where do you want to send {1} to?", pkmn.name), cmds, 99)
   23         next if cmd == 99 && @sendToBoxes == 2   # Can't cancel if must add to party
   24         break if cmd == 99   # Cancelling = send to a Box
   25         cmd += 1 if cmd >= 1 && @sendToBoxes == 2
   26         case cmd
   27         when 0   # Add to your party
   28           pbDisplay(_INTL("Choose a Pokémon in your party to send to your Boxes."))
   29           party_index = -1
   30           @scene.pbPartyScreen(0, (@sendToBoxes != 2), 1) do |idxParty, _partyScene|
   31             party_index = idxParty
   32             next true
   33           end
   34           next if party_index < 0   # Cancelled
   35           party_size = pbPlayer.party.length
   36           # Get chosen Pokémon and clear battle-related conditions
   37           send_pkmn = pbPlayer.party[party_index]
   38           @peer.pbOnLeavingBattle(self, send_pkmn, @usedInBattle[0][party_index], true)
   39           send_pkmn.statusCount = 0 if send_pkmn.status == :POISON   # Bad poison becomes regular
   40           send_pkmn.makeUnmega
   41           send_pkmn.makeUnprimal
   42           # Send chosen Pokémon to storage
   43           stored_box = @peer.pbStorePokemon(pbPlayer, send_pkmn)
   44           pbPlayer.party.delete_at(party_index)
   45           box_name = @peer.pbBoxName(stored_box)
   46           pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("{1} has been sent to Box \"{2}\".", send_pkmn.name, box_name))
   47           # Rearrange all remembered properties of party Pokémon
   48           (party_index...party_size).each do |idx|
   49             if idx < party_size - 1
   50               @initialItems[0][idx] = @initialItems[0][idx + 1]
   51               $game_temp.party_levels_before_battle[idx] = $game_temp.party_levels_before_battle[idx + 1]
   52               $game_temp.party_critical_hits_dealt[idx] = $game_temp.party_critical_hits_dealt[idx + 1]
   53               $game_temp.party_direct_damage_taken[idx] = $game_temp.party_direct_damage_taken[idx + 1]
   54             else
   55               @initialItems[0][idx] = nil
   56               $game_temp.party_levels_before_battle[idx] = nil
   57               $game_temp.party_critical_hits_dealt[idx] = nil
   58               $game_temp.party_direct_damage_taken[idx] = nil
   59             end
   60           end
   61           break
   62         when 1   # Send to a Box
   63           break
   64         when 2   # See X's summary
   65           pbFadeOutIn do
   66             summary_scene = PokemonSummary_Scene.new
   67             summary_screen = PokemonSummaryScreen.new(summary_scene, true)
   68             summary_screen.pbStartScreen([pkmn], 0)
   69           end
   70         when 3   # Check party
   71           @scene.pbPartyScreen(0, true, 2)
   72         end
   73       end
   74     end
   75     # Store as normal (add to party if there's space, or send to a Box if not)
   76     stored_box = @peer.pbStorePokemon(pbPlayer, pkmn)
   77     if stored_box < 0
   78       pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("{1} has been added to your party.", pkmn.name))
   79       @initialItems[0][pbPlayer.party.length - 1] = pkmn.item_id if @initialItems
   80       return
   81     end
   82     # Messages saying the Pokémon was stored in a PC box
   83     box_name = @peer.pbBoxName(stored_box)
   84     pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("{1} has been sent to Box \"{2}\"!", pkmn.name, box_name))
   85   end

   87   # Register all caught Pokémon in the Pokédex, and store them.
   88   def pbRecordAndStoreCaughtPokemon
   89     @caughtPokemon.each do |pkmn|
   90       pbSetCaught(pkmn)
   91       pbSetSeen(pkmn)   # In case the form changed upon leaving battle
   92       # Record the Pokémon's species as owned in the Pokédex
   93       if !pbPlayer.owned?(pkmn.species)
   94         pbPlayer.pokedex.set_owned(pkmn.species)
   95         if $player.has_pokedex && $player.pokedex.species_in_unlocked_dex?(pkmn.species)
   96           pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("{1}'s data was added to the Pokédex.", pkmn.name))
   97           pbPlayer.pokedex.register_last_seen(pkmn)
   98           @scene.pbShowPokedex(pkmn.species)
   99         end
  100       end
  101       # Record a Shadow Pokémon's species as having been caught
  102       pbPlayer.pokedex.set_shadow_pokemon_owned(pkmn.species) if pkmn.shadowPokemon?
  103       # Store caught Pokémon
  104       pbStorePokemon(pkmn)
  105     end
  106     @caughtPokemon.clear
  107   end

  110   # Throw a Poké Ball
  111   #=============================================================================
  112   def pbThrowPokeBall(idxBattler, ball, catch_rate = nil, showPlayer = false)
  113     # Determine which Pokémon you're throwing the Poké Ball at
  114     battler = nil
  115     if opposes?(idxBattler)
  116       battler = @battlers[idxBattler]
  117     else
  118       battler = @battlers[idxBattler].pbDirectOpposing(true)
  119     end
  120     battler = battler.allAllies[0] if battler.fainted?
  121     # Messages
  122     itemName = GameData::Item.get(ball).name
  123     if battler.fainted?
  124       if itemName.starts_with_vowel?
  125         pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} threw an {2}!", pbPlayer.name, itemName))
  126       else
  127         pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} threw a {2}!", pbPlayer.name, itemName))
  128       end
  129       pbDisplay(_INTL("But there was no target..."))
  130       return
  131     end
  132     if itemName.starts_with_vowel?
  133       pbDisplayBrief(_INTL("{1} threw an {2}!", pbPlayer.name, itemName))
  134     else
  135       pbDisplayBrief(_INTL("{1} threw a {2}!", pbPlayer.name, itemName))
  136     end
  137     # Animation of opposing trainer blocking Poké Balls (unless it's a Snag Ball
  138     # at a Shadow Pokémon)
  139     if trainerBattle? && !(GameData::Item.get(ball).is_snag_ball? && battler.shadowPokemon?)
  140       @scene.pbThrowAndDeflect(ball, 1)
  141       pbDisplay(_INTL("The Trainer blocked your Poké Ball! Don't be a thief!"))
  142       return
  143     end
  144     # Calculate the number of shakes (4=capture)
  145     pkmn = battler.pokemon
  146     @criticalCapture = false
  147     numShakes = pbCaptureCalc(pkmn, battler, catch_rate, ball)
  148     PBDebug.log("[Threw Poké Ball] #{itemName}, #{numShakes} shakes (4=capture)")
  149     # Animation of Ball throw, absorb, shake and capture/burst out
  150     @scene.pbThrow(ball, numShakes, @criticalCapture, battler.index, showPlayer)
  151     # Outcome message
  152     case numShakes
  153     when 0
  154       pbDisplay(_INTL("Oh no! The Pokémon broke free!"))
  155       Battle::PokeBallEffects.onFailCatch(ball, self, battler)
  156     when 1
  157       pbDisplay(_INTL("Aww! It appeared to be caught!"))
  158       Battle::PokeBallEffects.onFailCatch(ball, self, battler)
  159     when 2
  160       pbDisplay(_INTL("Aargh! Almost had it!"))
  161       Battle::PokeBallEffects.onFailCatch(ball, self, battler)
  162     when 3
  163       pbDisplay(_INTL("Gah! It was so close, too!"))
  164       Battle::PokeBallEffects.onFailCatch(ball, self, battler)
  165     when 4
  166       pbDisplayBrief(_INTL("Gotcha! {1} was caught!", pkmn.name))
  167       @scene.pbThrowSuccess   # Play capture success jingle
  168       pbRemoveFromParty(battler.index, battler.pokemonIndex)
  169       # Gain Exp
  170       if Settings::GAIN_EXP_FOR_CAPTURE
  171         battler.captured = true
  172         pbGainExp
  173         battler.captured = false
  174       end
  175       battler.pbReset
  176       if pbAllFainted?(battler.index)
  177         @decision = (trainerBattle?) ? 1 : 4   # Battle ended by win/capture
  178       end
  179       # Modify the Pokémon's properties because of the capture
  180       if GameData::Item.get(ball).is_snag_ball?
  181         pkmn.owner = Pokemon::Owner.new_from_trainer(pbPlayer)
  182       end
  183       Battle::PokeBallEffects.onCatch(ball, self, pkmn)
  184       pkmn.poke_ball = ball
  185       pkmn.makeUnmega if pkmn.mega?
  186       pkmn.makeUnprimal
  187       pkmn.update_shadow_moves if pkmn.shadowPokemon?
  188       pkmn.record_first_moves
  189       # Reset form
  190       pkmn.forced_form = nil if MultipleForms.hasFunction?(pkmn.species, "getForm")
  191       @peer.pbOnLeavingBattle(self, pkmn, true, true)
  192       # Make the Poké Ball and data box disappear
  193       @scene.pbHideCaptureBall(idxBattler)
  194       # Save the Pokémon for storage at the end of battle
  195       @caughtPokemon.push(pkmn)
  196     end
  197     if numShakes != 4
  198       @first_poke_ball = ball if !@poke_ball_failed
  199       @poke_ball_failed = true
  200     end
  201   end

  203   #=============================================================================
  204   # Calculate how many shakes a thrown Poké Ball will make (4 = capture)
  205   #=============================================================================
  206   def pbCaptureCalc(pkmn, battler, catch_rate, ball)
  207     return 4 if $DEBUG && Input.press?(Input::CTRL)
  208     # Get a catch rate if one wasn't provided
  209     catch_rate = pkmn.species_data.catch_rate if !catch_rate
  210     # Modify catch_rate depending on the Poké Ball's effect
  211     if !pkmn.species_data.has_flag?("UltraBeast") || ball == :BEASTBALL
  212       catch_rate = Battle::PokeBallEffects.modifyCatchRate(ball, catch_rate, self, battler)
  213     else
  214       catch_rate /= 10
  215     end
  216     # First half of the shakes calculation
  217     a = battler.totalhp
  218     b = battler.hp
  219     x = (((3 * a) - (2 * b)) * catch_rate.to_f) / (3 * a)
  220     # Calculation modifiers
  221     if battler.status == :SLEEP || battler.status == :FROZEN
  222       x *= 2.5
  223     elsif battler.status != :NONE
  224       x *= 1.5
  225     end
  226     x = x.floor
  227     x = 1 if x < 1
  228     # Definite capture, no need to perform randomness checks
  229     return 4 if x >= 255 || Battle::PokeBallEffects.isUnconditional?(ball, self, battler)
  230     # Second half of the shakes calculation
  231     y = (65_536 / ((255.0 / x)**0.1875)).floor
  232     # Critical capture check
  233     if Settings::ENABLE_CRITICAL_CAPTURES
  234       dex_modifier = 0
  235       numOwned = $player.pokedex.owned_count
  236       if numOwned > 600
  237         dex_modifier = 5
  238       elsif numOwned > 450
  239         dex_modifier = 4
  240       elsif numOwned > 300
  241         dex_modifier = 3
  242       elsif numOwned > 150
  243         dex_modifier = 2
  244       elsif numOwned > 30
  245         dex_modifier = 1
  246       end
  247       dex_modifier *= 2 if $bag.has?(:CATCHINGCHARM)
  248       c = x * dex_modifier / 12
  249       # Calculate the number of shakes
  250       if c > 0 && pbRandom(256) < c
  251         @criticalCapture = true
  252         return 4 if pbRandom(65_536) < y
  253         return 0
  254       end
  255     end
  256     # Calculate the number of shakes
  257     numShakes = 0
  258     4.times do |i|
  259       break if numShakes < i
  260       numShakes += 1 if pbRandom(65_536) < y
  261     end
  262     return numShakes
  263   end
  264 end
